steps.text: Hey
Hey
Did I wake you up, or were you already drifting in and out?

options.text: I was already awake, don’t worry
A little, but it’s fine, I’m glad you texted

steps.text: Good
I keep forgetting you can’t really do much besides stare at that screen right now
I’m sorry
I just wanted to check in before I get busy again
How are you feeling today, really?
Still stiff, and it’s annoying not being able to get up whenever I want
But you’re healing, and that’s what matters, even if it feels slow
You also need to stop blaming yourself for everything
You didn’t choose to get hurt, and you’re not a burden for needing help
I’m trying
It’s just hard to feel useful when I’m stuck in bed all day
I know
By the way, how does your new phone feel so far?
Does everything look like it transferred correctly from the old one?
Yeah, surprisingly
It’s fast, and everything seems to be in the right place
I barely had to redo my settings
Good
The guy who sold it to me kept insisting it was a solid model
Thanks again for getting it for me
I know you didn’t have to, but it really helps right now
Of course it helps
You deserve nice things too, even if you don’t always believe that
…Okay
Actually, there’s one thing I still need for the new phone
It’s asking for a clean contact photo, and the one I had is ancient
Oh
You want a new photo of me for your contacts?
Alright, give me a second
2 MINUTES LATER
There
If that one looks terrible, you’re not allowed to complain
It’s perfect
Thanks
Try to rest
I’ll bring you something to eat later and check on you again
Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
